records.issue_text: packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1060 — When no organizer or event-type destination calendar exists, the field is initialized to null, so optional `push` calls silently discard all collected collective-host calendars
records.rationale: The diff initializes evt.destinationCalendar to `null` when neither eventType nor organizer has one, then later does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` under the COLLECTIVE branch. Optional chaining means the push is a no-op when the field is null, so destination calendars collected from non-organizer collective hosts (users.slice(1) can have destinationCalendar even if the organizer doesn't) are silently discarded — a real correctness defect introduced by this diff.
